<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="DrawIO" version="24.7.17"> <diagram name="Диаграмма состояний — Телефон (Вариант 5/1)" id="lab4-phone-state"> <mxGraphModel dx="1250" dy="620" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1200" pageHeight="580" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="start" value="" style="ellipse;html=1;fillColor=#27AE60;strokeColor=#1E8449;strokeWidth=1.5;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="291" y="20" width="28" height="28" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="st_waiting" value="WaitingState (Ожидание)
entry / ожидание вызова (линия свободна)
makeCall(target) [вызов не прошёл] / ожидание
topUpBalance(amount) [amount > 0] / balance += amount
answerCall() / отказ, endCall() / отказ" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=16;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=11;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="110" y="100" width="390" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="st_calling" value="CallingState (Звонок)
entry / идут гудки вызова абонента
topUpBalance(amount) [amount > 0] / balance += amount
makeCall(target) / отказ (линия занята)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=16;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=11;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="740" y="100" width="390" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="st_talking" value="TalkingState (Разговор)
entry / голосовое соединение установлено
topUpBalance(amount) [amount > 0] / balance += amount
makeCall(target) / отказ (идёт разговор)
answerCall() / отказ (уже на линии)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=16;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=11;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="740" y="400" width="390" height="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="st_blocked" value="BlockedState (Заблокирован: нет средств)
entry / звонки заблокированы (balance <= 0)
topUpBalance(amount) [balance <= 0] / заблокирован
makeCall(target) / отказ, answerCall() / отказ
endCall() / отказ" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=16;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#000000;fontSize=11;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="110" y="400" width="390" height="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_init_wait" value="[balance > 0]" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#2C3E50;strokeWidth=1.2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=10;fontFamily=Helvetica;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" edge="1" parent="1" source="start" target="st_waiting"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_init_block" value="[balance <= 0]" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#2C3E50;strokeWidth=1.2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=10;fontFamily=Helvetica;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" edge="1" parent="1" source="start" target="st_blocked"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="45" y="34" /> <mxPoint x="45" y="458" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_wait_call" value="makeCall(target) [balance > 0 и вызов прошёл]" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#2C3E50;strokeWidth=1.2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=10;fontFamily=Helvetica;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" edge="1" parent="1" source="st_waiting" target="st_calling"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_call_wait" value="endCall() [отмена вызова]" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#2C3E50;strokeWidth=1.2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=10;fontFamily=Helvetica;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" edge="1" parent="1" source="st_calling" target="st_waiting"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_call_talk" value="answerCall()" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#2C3E50;strokeWidth=1.2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=10;fontFamily=Helvetica;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" edge="1" parent="1" source="st_calling" target="st_talking"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_talk_wait" value="endCall() [balance - callCost > 0]" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#2C3E50;strokeWidth=1.2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=10;fontFamily=Helvetica;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" edge="1" parent="1" source="st_talking" target="st_waiting"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="620" y="432" /> <mxPoint x="620" y="310" /> <mxPoint x="352" y="310" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_talk_block" value="endCall() [balance - callCost <= 0]" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#2C3E50;strokeWidth=1.2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=10;fontFamily=Helvetica;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" edge="1" parent="1" source="st_talking" target="st_blocked"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_block_wait" value="topUpBalance(amount) [balance > 0]" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#2C3E50;strokeWidth=1.2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=10;fontFamily=Helvetica;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" edge="1" parent="1" source="st_blocked" target="st_waiting"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
